prose: Show HN: trustmebro.reviews presents 13 million opinions on 48,000 products extracted from Reddit and Hacker News. The page claims 99% of excerpts are verified against their source, covers 301 categories, and has detected 4,158 copy-paste campaigns. Sample excerpts include credit-card offers, turntable repair and PC parts advice. Numbers are the site's own claims.
highlights: 13M opinions on 48K products from Reddit and HN
Claims 99% of excerpts verified against sources; 301 categories
4,158 copy-paste campaigns detected, per the site
